mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_short_term_memory ( user_id, conversation_id, role, content, token_count, message_order, metadata, is_deleted, expired_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{tokenCount}, 0), #{messageOrder}, COALESCE(#{metadata, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{deleted}, FALSE), #{expiredAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, conversation_id, role, content, token_count, message_order, metadata, is_deleted, expired_at, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_short_term_memory WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, user_id, conversation_id, role, content, token_count, message_order, metadata, is_deleted, expired_at, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_short_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY message_order DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) t ORDER BY t.message_order ASC

SELECT id, user_id, conversation_id, role, content, token_count, message_order, metadata, is_deleted, expired_at, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_short_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND message_order BETWEEN #{startOrder} AND #{endOrder} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY message_order ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_short_term_memory WHERE expired_at IS NOT NULL AND expired_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
